patches[] ORDER IS APPLY ORDER. Merge each as its own --no-ff merge, in this order.
Two branches lack the up- prefix because they are heads of open cross-fork PRs:
renaming such a branch CLOSES the PR (measured 2026-09-21 on #18307). They get the
prefix if and when those PRs close.
status 'fork-only' means there is no upstream PR and none is planned: the patch
is ours to carry and upstream_pr is null. Every other entry is 'open-upstream'.

A patch whose changes cannot exist on the upstream tag gets a stacked up- branch: its row carries depends_on and a base that is the dependency set rather than the tag, the branch is built on the merge of exactly those dependencies AT THEIR MANIFEST SHAS, it is listed after all of them, and it is fork-only. up-response-scope-think-budget is the first.

patches.title: gemma4: a channel re-opened inside thinking leaks into the reasoning
patches.note: Requested by xollama (#1547). The model writes <|channel> inside an open thinking block when it means to close it or begin another thought; the thinking state passed it through with its channel name, so the reasoning carried a literal '<|channel>thought' (pandorum 2026-10-16, gemma4 v9-agentic, two blocks of one run; once as '<|channel><thought>'). Reproduced by xollama on dev 817123de7 streamed one rune at a time. A re-opened <|channel> before <channel|> and <|tool_call> is now dropped with its name (thought\n, <thought>\n, <thought>, or a bare thought at done) and the block goes on, the next text starting on a new line; a partial <|channel> is held back like the other two tags. The tool-call-in-thinking half is gemma4-toolcall-in-thinking's and is unchanged. Tests in their own file (gemma4_reopened_channel_test.go, whole and rune-by-rune): all 6 fail on the base and pass with the fix; go test ./model/parsers/ passes; golangci-lint --new-from-rev=6bb6f388 0 issues. Integrated into think-budget by cherry-pick -x (36c0592d), clean. patches.title: llm: parse llama-server output by line and count a speculative draft's buffers
patches.note: Reported by backup_models (#1764): pandorum v0.40.4-thinkbudget, Qwen3.5 9B Q6_K with an MTP draft fully on an RTX 5080, /api/ps 373 MiB then 905 MiB against 11.8 GB in nvidia-smi. Replay of the real load at chunk sizes 1..4096 and whole: 10167.88 MiB GPU, = llama-server's own 'projected to use 10167 MiB'; the base gives 0..7991.88. go test ./llm/ passes on the branch and on think-budget. patches.note: 2026-10-23.
